programme.title: Little women
programme.desc: The times of the Civil War.In the absence of their father, who is serving in the military away from the family, the four March sisters from Orchard House are cared for by their mother alone.Marmee wants them to find their own path and helps them enter adulthood.Each of them has a different personality.The oldest Meg dreams of becoming an actress.Family-oriented and warm, Beth has a talent for playing the piano.Jo, an aspiring writer, pursues her goal with her characteristic energy and tenacity.Amy, a bit smart, wants to become a painter.Despite their own problems, the girls are not indifferent to other people's suffering.Young women will get to know the taste of first loves and disappointments.Fate subjects them to tests, after which their lives will never be the same again.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Three stories about man's pursuit of immortality.16th century.In the forests of South America, Spanish conquistador Tomas Creo (Hugh Jackman), head over heels in love with Queen Isabella I of Castile (Rachel Weisz), is looking for the legendary tree of life for her.The ruler wants to use them to finally solve the problem of the power struggle with a certain high-ranking cardinal.In the 20th century, scientist Tom Creo (Hugh Jackman) tries to find a cure that will save his seriously ill wife Izzi (Rachel Weisz).A man cannot come to terms with the fact that his beloved is dying.He decides to devote himself to finding a way to overcome death.Six centuries later, astronaut Tommy (Hugh Jackman) travels through space in a glass ball.He wants to reach the golden nebula, hoping to bring Izzi back to life.A science-fiction drama by Darren Aronofsky, author of "Requiem for a Dream", "Black Swan" and "The Wrestler".

programme.title: Queer
programme.desc: Year 1950, Mexico.William Lee (Daniel Craig), a middle-aged American, spends his days almost alone.He contacts several people from a small American community of students and bar owners.The arrival of another student, Eugene Allerton (Drew Starkey), in town makes him realize for the first time that an intimate bond is possible.The men first become friends, then their relationship turns into a romance.As a couple, they go to South America in search of a drug that supposedly gives the power of telepathy.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Romy (Nicole Kidman) leads a stable and prosperous life.She manages a modern, dynamically developing company, lives in a comfortable house with her devoted husband Jacob (Antonio Banderas) and two teenage daughters.Her everyday life changes when a young intern, Samuel (Harris Dickinson), appears.Despite the age difference, Romy and Samuel begin a fiery romance.The woman begins to rediscover herself, although this decision may mean the loss of both her professional position and her family.She is faced with the decision of whether to follow her own desires, risking everything she has achieved so far.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A mysterious plague turns most people into bloodthirsty zombies.Only a few manage to avoid infection.This lucky group includes a clumsy and clumsy Columbus student.The boy is afraid of almost everything.The prospect of living in a world overrun by beasts terrifies him.Meanwhile, his friend, the brave Tallahassee, is excited about the whole situation.He is a tough guy who intends to single-handedly kill every monster that stands in his way.The men must fight the monsters together.They can count on the help of the sisters - Wichita and Little Rock.The girls try to alleviate the tense atmosphere between the men.For them, enduring each other's company is as difficult as getting rid of zombies.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Recidivist Callum Lynch sentenced to death is not executed.After a fake execution, he ends up in a secret laboratory.There he meets Rikkin and his daughter Sofia.Scientists have a mysterious device that allows them to access the records of ancestors' actions stored in their genes.The criminal is to connect with the consciousness of Aguilar from Spain, who lived during the Great Inquisition and obtained the Apple of Eden, which provides control over emotions.By using this item, you can supposedly eliminate aggression in people.The daredevil travels to the Middle Ages.He discovers that he is a descendant of a member of the Assassin secret society.Over time, he learns what a big mistake he made when he trusted Sofia and her father.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The only companion of the lonely and malicious Grinch is the dog Max. The green creature only leaves the cave in search of food.Meanwhile, the residents of Whosiów are eagerly awaiting a special time of the year, Christmas.Wanting to keep the peace, the Grinch plans to spoil the grand celebrations and kidnap Santa Claus.At the same time, Cindy-Lou and her friends intend to capture a Lappish benefactor to thank him for helping the girl's busy mother.Two opposing intentions will face an inevitable confrontation.Another film adaptation of the adventures of a character created by a children's book writer, Dr.Seuss.Previously, Jim Carrey played the green creature in the 2000 film "The Grinch: No Christmas."In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Jarosław Boberek, Lila Wassermann, Ewa Prus and Karol Kwiatkowski.The carol was performed by Katarzyna Owczarz, Małgorzata Szymańska, Adam Krylik and Krzysztof Pietrzak.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

programme.title: Veep 4
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).The entire team must contend with the ambitious Dan Egan (Reid Scott) and the confident White House employee Jonah Ryan (Timothy Simons).

programme.title: Wunderschöner
programme.desc: 50-year-old Nadine (Anneke Kim Sarnau) does everything to look young.When she discovers that her husband (Godehard Giese) is cheating on her, she falls into depression.The couple's daughter Lilly (Emilia Packard) is interested in the classes lectured by feminist Vicky (Nora Tschirner).Enno, the narrator's boyfriend, participates in the project of her new colleague Trevor (Malick Bauer).He doesn't know that his beloved will soon lose her head for him.Julie (Emilia Schüle), a new TV production manager, suffers from loneliness.Her difficult relationship with her co-worker increases her doubts about herself.Sonja (Karoline Herfurth) and Milan (Friedrich Mücke) go to family therapy.When it comes to light that the man has a new partner, the woman starts dating.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: Neuilly-Poissy
programme.desc: Daniel (Max Boublil) is a successful entrepreneur.He successfully combines running a business with a successful family life.However, when financial irregularities are discovered in his company, he is forced to exchange a luxurious apartment in the city of Neuilly for a cell in the prison in Poissy.From one day to the next, he finds himself in a world whose rules he does not understand.Moreover, he is a Jew and now he will be hanging out with Muslims.However, thanks to his sense of humor and the ability to cope with difficult situations, Daniel tries to adapt to the new reality.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

credits.actor: Christopher Robin Aged 6 Months - Stanley Hamlin

programme.title: Beautiful
programme.desc: The intertwined adventures of several women who are looking for happiness and fulfillment at different stages of life.Magda (Marta Nieradkiewicz) tries to reconcile raising children and running a home with her professional ambitions.Distrustful Basia (Marta Ścisłowicz) avoids love, even though she wants it very much.Krysia (Hanna Śleszyńska), a married woman for 30 years, tries to arouse a bit of enthusiasm in the bored and apathetic Władek (Olaf Lubaszenko).Businesswoman Agata (Katarzyna Herman) is successful at work, but cannot find a common language with her daughter.Julia (Kamila Urzędowska) tries to make it in an industry that values ​​only youth and beauty.She discovers how much she will have to sacrifice.Polish remake of the German comedy "Wunderschön" from 2022.

programme.title: G20
programme.desc: During the G20 summit, the leaders of the world's influential countries become the targets of terrorists.US President Danielle Sutton (Viola Davis) miraculously manages to escape the attackers.She must face the enemy alone.

programme.title: Kinds of Kindness
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated stories.Emma Stone, Jesse Plemons and Willem Dafoe play various roles.A corporate manager (Jesse Plemons) lives under the dictates of an eccentric boss (Willem Dafoe).She puts his well-being above her own and doesn't question any outlandish demands.Stripped of his dignity, he tries to free himself from total control.A policeman (Jesse Plemons) misses his wife (Emma Stone) - a biologist who disappeared during a research expedition.A woman who survived the disaster returns, but her marriage is put to the test.The husband becomes paranoid and is not sure whether this is the same beloved he once married.The heroes of the last story are members of a sect who are looking for a person with the power to resurrect the dead.The work of Yórgos Lánthimos - the director of "Poor Creatures", which won four Oscars.For his performance, Jesse Plemons was awarded the Palme d'Or at Cannes.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: The year is 1932. Twin brothers Smoke and Stack (double role of Michael B. Jordan), who have a difficult past, return from Chicago to their hometown in Mississippi.They try to escape from problems and a life of crime.They establish a music club for black people and hope for a new beginning.Their enemy, however, are dark, sinister forces that they must face.At stake is not only the lives of the brothers and their loved ones, but also their culture, history and memory.A dark cinema combining elements of action, horror and a musical drawing on the blues tradition.It is a story about an attempt at redemption and the fight against an invisible evil that symbolizes the weight of the past and past sins.

programme.title: Tempete
programme.desc: Zoe (Carmen Kassovitz) grew up surrounded by horses in her parents' (Mélanie Laurent and Pio Marmai) racing stable.This is her place on earth.He dreams of one day becoming a jockey like his father.When a new foal is born, the girl is the first to notice its potential to become a champion.The family's life changes one tragic night, when a scared mare accidentally injures Zoe.The teenager, overcome with despair, completely breaks down.Thanks to the support of her parents and the help of the stable boy (Kacey Mottet Klein), who has an extraordinary gift for communicating with horses, Zoe decides to overcome adversity and regain what seemed lost.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: Transylvania.Dr. Henry Augustus Wolfgang (Richard Brake) and his not very bright assistant Floop (Jorge Garcia) want to create a perfect man from the dead bodies of geniuses of the past century.By mistake, instead of the brain of a great scientist, they implant the organ of his twin brother, a bad comedian, into the creature they created.This is how Herman Potwornicki (Jeff Daniel Phillips) is created.When Wolfgang decides to show it to the world on TV, he is devastated.However, the uncouth, joking giant attracts the attention of the unmarried and undead Lily (Sheri Moon), who is fed up with unsuccessful dates.The girl finds Herman and they quickly become a couple.The future son-in-law, although he gained fame and won Lily's heart, does not like her father, a vampire and a refined count (Daniel Roebuck).However, the lovers get married.Due to the intrigues of the count's cunning ex-wife, Zoya Krupp (Catherine Schell) and her assistant, the werewolf Lester (Tomas Boykin), they lose their palace and fortune.They decide to go to America, where Herman intends to conquer Hollywood.They start a new life in a ruined house in the suburbs.A colorful production referring to the series from the 1960s. Director Rob Zombie is his big fan.

programme.title: Noah: Chosen by God
programme.desc: The distant past.Na skutek niegodziwości potomków Kaina, mieszkańców dużych miast, świat pogrąża się w upadku.Jedynie przedstawiciele rodu Seta nadal wykonują wolę Stwórcy.Pewnej nocy były wojownik i uzdrowiciel, Noe (Russell Crowe), ma koszmarny sen.Widzi w nim gigantyczną powódź, która niszczy świat.Along with his wife Naameh (Jennifer Connelly) and three sons, he visits his grandfather Methuselah (Anthony Hopkins) to seek his advice.He discovers that his dream is actually a prediction of the great flood.Noe zyskuje świadomość, że został wybrany przez Stwórcę, by ocalić życie niewinnych.With the help of stone giants called Guardians, he begins work on an ark that will be a shelter for various animal species.Po latach, gdy widmo katastrofy staje się coraz bardziej realne, olbrzymi statek jest prawie gotowy.Then the descendant of the first murderer, the self-proclaimed ruler Tubal-kain (Ray Winstone), demands a place in the ark for himself and his subjects.

programme.title: The Ghost of Lord Farquaad
programme.desc: Shrek and Fiona are going to the hotel where they are going to spend their honeymoon.They are accompanied by a Donkey.At one point, Farquaad's ghost appears to the couple.He sends Thelonius to kidnap the ogre's wife.

programme.title: The Inventor
programme.desc: The brilliant inventor Leonardo da Vinci cannot satisfy his enormous curiosity about the world.In search of inspiration, he leaves Italy and lives at the French court, where he can freely experiment by inventing flying machines, amazing vehicles and examining the human body.He comes up with the idea of ​​creating an ideal city and, together with the adventurous and bold Princess Margaret, tries to convince the ruler of his vision.Together they are also looking for answers about the meaning of life.However, the king expects something down-to-earth from the artist and researcher - he wants a large statue to show the world his power.

programme.title: Frieda's Case
programme.desc: The year 1904. A seamstress accused of a crime becomes the center of a trial that exposes the injustices of the legal system.

programme.title: The Tourist
programme.desc: A man (Jamie Dornan) traveling through the wilderness has an accident.His car is rammed by a tanker and he barely escapes with his life.When he wakes up injured in the hospital, he doesn't remember anything.He doesn't know what happened or who he is.He tries to use all the meetings with people and the clues he receives to discover his identity and past.He must do this before his enemies find him.A suspenseful, mysterious story of a man who faces amnesia and a dark past.
